tools.name: get_winback_overview
tools.description: What Winback does, who it is for, what it needs and what it does not do. Use this when someone asks how to win back churned subscribers of an iOS, Android or Stripe subscription app.

tools.name: estimate_win_back_revenue
tools.description: Same formula as https://winbackhq.com/tools/win-back-revenue-calculator/ : people lost per segment times a return rate, times price, over up to 6 months, minus the 15% fee. Default return rates: cancelled 20% (RevenueCat SOSA 2026 monthly reactivation within a year, a reference not a forecast), bill

tools.name: get_apple_retention_facts
tools.description: Sourced facts on App Store billing retry, grace periods, win-back offers and Retention Messaging, for founders planning a win-back.
